mapper.select: SELECT MIN(dw_time) FROM oms_cargo_order_shipment WHERE cargo_order_id = #{cargoOrderId} AND deleted = 0 AND dw_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT id, cargo_order_id, biz_root_id, shipment_no, po_no, shipping_mark, carton_qty, pallet_qty, weight, cbm, dw_time, group_code, remark, create_time FROM oms_cargo_order_shipment WHERE cargo_order_id = #{cargoOrderId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT s.* FROM oms_cargo_order_shipment s INNER JOIN oms_cargo_order o ON o.id = s.cargo_order_id AND o.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ( SELECT cargo_order_id FROM oms_cargo_order WHERE container_order_id = #{containerOrderId} AND deleted = 0 UNION SELECT cargo_order_id FROM oms_container_cargo_order_rel WHERE container_order_id = #{containerOrderId} AND deleted = 0 ) rel ON rel.cargo_order_id = o.id WHERE s.deleted = 0
